entries.name: Cristopher Sánchez
entries.reason: Strong strikeout stuff this season, boosted by elite swing-and-miss stuff (K%/whiff%), an opponent that's been genuinely weak vs LHP lately, not just weak on paper (their last 29 games specifically vs this handedness), a long-innings workload expectation, and locked-in command over their last starts (K-BB% of 22.8%); tempered by warm weather that can favor the hitter. entries.outsReason: Projected for 20.5 outs (6.3 innings), supported by a track record of a long leash (96 pitches/game this season), getting deep into games (6.3 IP/start), elite command (K-BB% of 21.7%), and a bullpen that's been leaned on hard lately (4.3 relief innings/game over their last 3), giving the manager real reason to stretch him out.
